description: This Java source file defines a test suite for entity management within the Apache OFBiz framework. It contains various test methods exercising entity modeling, CRUD operations, cache behavior, XML serialization, transaction management, and data querying. Its purpose is to verify the correctness and robustness of the entity layer implementations.

classes.name: EntityTestSuite
classes.description: A JUnit test suite class extending EntityTestCase, containing numerous test methods for verifying entity operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: testModels
methods.description: Tests the retrieval and modification of entity model metadata, including adding and removing fields.

methods.name: testMakeValue
methods.description: Tests creating, storing, and querying entity values, including batch creation.

methods.name: testUpdateValue
methods.description: Verifies updating of entity values via put and store methods, including observer notifications.

methods.name: testRemoveValue
methods.description: Tests removing entity values and ensuring they are no longer retrievable.

methods.name: testCreateAllValues
methods.description: Creates multiple entity instances in batch and verifies their existence.

methods.name: testEntityCache
methods.description: Exercises cache behaviors, including cache retrieval, update, storeByCondition, and removeByCondition impacts.

methods.name: testXmlSerialization
methods.description: Serializes entity values to XML and deserializes back, testing data integrity.

methods.name: flushAndRecreateTree
methods.description: Creates a test tree structure of nodes with specified description prefix in the entity store.

methods.name: testCreateTree
methods.description: Tests storing a tree of nodes and verifies correct counts.

methods.name: testAddMembersToTree
methods.description: Adds member entities to a tree structure and verifies proper storage.

methods.name: purgeTestingByTypeId
methods.description: Removes all entities of a certain testing type id pattern.

methods.name: createNodeMembers
methods.description: Creates node and associated testing entities and adds members to nodes.

methods.name: testCountViews
methods.description: Tests querying view-entity and count functionalities.

methods.name: testFindDistinct
methods.description: Tests distinct selection queries and retrievals.

methods.name: testNotLike
methods.description: Verifies querying entities with NOT LIKE conditions.

methods.name: testForeignKeyCreate
methods.description: Attempts to create entities with foreign key dependencies, expecting constraints enforcement.

methods.name: testForeignKeyRemove
methods.description: Attempts to remove entities with foreign key dependencies, verifying constraint violations.

methods.name: testRemoveNodeMemberAndTesting
methods.description: Removes node members and testing entities via related objects.

methods.name: testStoreByCondition
methods.description: Updates multiple entities matching a condition with specified fields.

methods.name: testRemoveByCondition
methods.description: Removes entities matching specified conditions.

methods.name: testRemoveByPK
methods.description: Removes entities using primary keys obtained from entity instances.

methods.name: testRemoveType
methods.description: Removes entities of specific types, then re-creates them for testing.

methods.name: testCreateManyAndStoreAtOnce
methods.description: Creates many entities and stores them in bulk, then verifies the count.

methods.name: testCreateManyAndStoreOneAtATime
methods.description: Creates many entities one by one, then verifies their creation.

methods.name: testEntityListIterator
methods.description: Tests iteration over entity list via EntityListIterator.

methods.name: testTransactionUtilRollback
methods.description: Verifies that transaction rollbacks correctly remove created data.

methods.name: testTransactionUtilMoreThanTimeout
methods.description: Tests transaction timeout behavior when sleep exceeds timeout period.

methods.name: testTransactionUtilLessThanTimeout
methods.description: Tests successful commit within timeout period.

methods.name: testFieldTypes
methods.description: Sets various field types on an entity and verifies correct storage and retrieval.

methods.name: getTestId
methods.description: Utility method to generate standardized test IDs with padded numbers.

methods.name: testEntitySaxReaderCreation
methods.description: Tests parsing XML to create entities and updating entity fields from XML.

methods.name: testEntitySaxReaderCreateSkip
methods.description: Tests the XML parsing's ability to skip existing entities and only create missing ones.

methods.name: testEntitySaxReaderUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating existing entities via XML input.

methods.name: testEntitySaxReaderReplace
methods.description: Tests replacing entities via XML parsing with create-replace semantics.
